en.title: BioGC – Laboratory of Bioinformatics and Clinical Genomics | Fiocruz
en.description: Bioinformatics and Clinical Genomics Laboratory (BioGC) at Instituto Carlos Chagas – Fiocruz. Research in genomics, transcriptomics, and bioinformatics applied to health.
en.header_title: Laboratory of Bioinformatics and Clinical Genomics
en.hero_text: Integrating genomics, bioinformatics, and computational intelligence.
en.section_about_text: The Laboratory of Bioinformatics and Clinical Genomics (BioGC) is a center of excellence at the Carlos Chagas Institute – Fiocruz Paraná.
en.section_about_mission: Mission: Generate knowledge and innovation in bioinformatics and clinical genomics, contributing to the advancement of science and public health, in line with SUS principles.
